description: Vite+ updates with core and Vitest versions derived from its published manifest. Opt in only when Vite+ owns the test toolchain.

transformTemplates: ($root := $; $component := "{{{packageName}}}" = "vite-plus" ? "root" : "{{{packageName}}}" = "@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core" ? "vite" : "vitest"; $version := function($manifest) { $component = "root" ? $manifest.version : $component = "vite" ? $substringAfter($manifest.dependencies.vite, "npm:@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core@") : $manifest.dependencies.vitest }; $latest := $root."dist-tags".latest; $manifest := $lookup($root.versions, $latest); $target := $version($manifest); $core := $substringAfter($manifest.dependencies.vite, "npm:@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core@"); $assert($exists($match($latest, /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/)) and $exists($match($target, /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/)) and $exists($lookup($root.time, $latest)) and $manifest.version = $latest and $exists($match($core, /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/)) and $exists($match($manifest.dependencies.vitest, /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/)), "Vite+ latest must publish an exact stable component and timestamp"); {"releases": $each($root.versions, function($manifest, $release) { ($value := $version($manifest); $exists($match($release, /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/)) and $exists($value) and $exists($match($value, /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/)) and $exists($lookup($root.time, $release)) ? {"version": $value, "releaseTimestamp": $lookup($root.time, $release)} ) }), "tags": {"latest": $target}, "sourceUrl": $component != "vitest" ? "https://github.com/voidzero-dev/vite-plus" : "https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest"})

packageRules.description: Move Vite+, its core, and the bundled Vitest ecosystem together. A major member gates the whole group.
Use one validated Vite+ release manifest for the parent and every bundled component.
